title: Grateful Dead Live at Pauley Pavilion, UCLA on 1982-02-21
lineage: Dat (Sony PCM-R500) > Apogee aes/ebu cable > Sound Devices 744T (wav 16/44.1)> Adobe Audition CC 2019 > TLH flac16

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture with a smoking Shakedown Jam, powerful Not Fade Away build‑up and chef’s kiss Stella Blue.
ai_review.review: The recording is a clean soundboard mix that lets the band’s energy shine through, highlighted by an inspired Shakedown Jam and a soaring transition into Not Fade Away and Stella Blue. Reviewers rave about the unique drums‑and‑space moment in the hallway, and despite one low star rating, the overall vibe is overwhelmingly positive.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviewers praise the musical performance (standout jams) and the soundboard quality; one outlier low star rating creates some uncertainty, leading to a solid but not flawless score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Soundboard mix described as crisp and excellent; no technical complaints noted.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong flow with a memorable drums‑and‑space segment and seamless build into the second set highlights.
